name: Submit and inspect a service request
description: Verifies a customer can submit a request and inspect its recorded price, countdown and status history.
steps: Open NIN Validation, enter an 11-digit NIN and choose No record found
Submit the request and note its reference
Open Request history and expand the request
Verify the countdown, ₦1,000 price and Submitted timeline entry
expected: The customer's request persists with a 72-hour countdown, recorded ₦1,000 NIN Validation price and initial status history.

name: Super Agent manages pricing and publishes status
description: Verifies the Super Agent can change future service pricing and publish status updates.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Super Agent account
Set NIN Validation to ₦1,200 and save
Open a submitted request and set status to Processing with a progress note
Publish the update and inspect the status history
expected: The new price is saved for future requests and the updated status/note is recorded in the request timeline.

name: Inspect request details on mobile
description: Verifies the customer can inspect any request and its update trail on a phone.
steps: Sign in as a customer with a request
Review service details, price, countdown and status timeline
expected: The request details and update timeline display on mobile without horizontal overflow.

name: Reject invalid requests and protect pricing
description: Verifies invalid submissions are rejected and customers cannot access the Super Agent pricing manager.
steps: Sign in as a regular customer
Submit an invalid NIN validation request
Attempt to open the Super Agent queue and pricing manager
expected: Invalid requests are rejected and regular customers cannot read other customers' requests or change pricing.

name: Show a retry path when request submission fails
description: Verifies temporary backend failure does not show false success.
steps: Sign in and complete a valid service request
Submit while the API returns a simulated unavailable response
expected: A visible error appears, no success reference is shown, and the customer can retry later.
